Lead cast: a cartoon magician rabbit in a top hat whose tricks misfire, and a rainbow-wheeled toy skateboard. Soft lavender-gray backdrop; the glyph is warm oak-brown. The voice says the second 板 as the strokes rush into the middle. 3.0-4.5s: a rainbow-wheeled toy skateboard whooshes through and bumps the pieces together into 板 while the rabbit slides off the back. 4.5-5.0s: the voice says 黑板 (ㄏㄟ ㄅㄢˇ) as a small green chalkboard pops from his hat with a happy doodle of a star, drawn in light chalk strokes only. Final hold: 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is still; the rabbit rides the skateboard in tiny circles at the bottom edge. The glyph holds fully still and clearly readable for the last 3 seconds. Voice: one gentle off-screen voice in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, slow with crisp tones, reads precisely 板、板、黑板 = ㄅㄢˇ、ㄅㄢˇ、ㄏㄟ ㄅㄢˇ, character, character, word, and nothing after it. Keep any background music quieter than the voice. The vocabulary word is audio only. conceptZh: 消防小隊想把紅色木板疊成高塔去搆屋頂上的小鈴鐺，調皮的水管把消防員沖得東倒西歪，最後再放上一小塊木片，整座塔搖搖晃晃嘩啦倒下，木板堆成「板」字，消防員被埋在裡面只剩眼睛，大怪獸舉起小黑板替他畫星星。
object: a stack of bright red wooden planks from a chunky toy fire engine, piled into a wobbly tower by a round-headed toy firefighter
morph: the swaying plank tower topples in one crash; the falling planks tumble into a heap that lands as the glyph 板, the left pile stacking into 木 and the right pile into 反, with the toy firefighter buried underneath and only his eyes poking out
creativeAngle: 改用「疊高再倒塌」的實體笑料：消防小隊疊木板塔，木板本身就是「板」，倒下的那一刻直接堆出字形，木字旁和反字分左右兩堆，筆畫關係清楚；水管搗蛋與大怪獸的小黑板讓三次發音都有畫面對應，和前版魔術兔與滑板的做法完全不同。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip. Teaching subject: the single Traditional Chinese glyph 板 (board), correctly formed, built from saturated fire-engine-red wooden planks against a pale cream background, ending centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with margins. Lead: a chunky toy fire engine with big black wheels and a round-headed toy firefighter figure with a glossy helmet, plus a mischievous white hose that wriggles on its own. One supporting character: a huge round fuzzy blue cartoon monster with one horn and a goofy grin. Plain floor, nothing busy behind.

0.0–1.5s: the toy fire engine screeches in from the left. A tiny brass bell dangles high at the top of frame. The firefighter points up at it, puffs out his chest, and slaps the first red plank flat on the floor. The voice says the first 板 exactly as that plank lands with a clack.

1.5–3.5s: he stacks planks faster and faster, standing on tiptoe on the engine roof, the tower swaying wider each time. The hose rears up like a snake, sprays him in the face, and he slides off the stack with a squeak while the tower leans and rights itself. The monster waddles in from the right to watch, turns around, and its fluffy rear nudges the engine; the tower wobbles even harder.

3.5–4.5s: the firefighter, dripping, balances one tiny red wood chip on the very top. Everyone freezes. The bell sways. One long pause.

4.5–5.0s: the whole tower topples in one big tumbling crash with cartoon squash-and-stretch and a puff of dust. The planks on the left stack into the 木 radical: one upright plank, a short crossbar, two splayed legs. The planks on the right settle into 反: a plank leaning as the top-left slanting stroke, a long plank across the top, and the 又 beneath. The voice says the second 板 as the last plank snaps into place. The firefighter is buried under the lower-left legs, only two blinking eyes poking out.

5.0–8.0s: the glyph 板 holds perfectly still, centered and fully readable. The monster, grinning, lifts a small green chalkboard from behind its back, and the voice says 黑板 as a chalk star gets scribbled on it in a single light stroke. The buried eyes blink happily; the hose wriggles a little victory wave in the bottom corner, never touching the strokes.

Voice: one warm off-screen voice in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, slow with crisp tones, reads precisely 板、板、黑板 (ㄅㄢˇ、ㄅㄢˇ、ㄏㄟ ㄅㄢˇ), character, character, word, and nothing after it. Any background music stays quieter than the voice. The vocabulary word is audio only. The glyph 板 is the only text on screen: no subtitles, captions, labels, watermark, logos, flashing or strobing effects; all characters are stylized toys or cartoon creatures, with no real people or realistic human figures.
